Title: Samyang's Curry Is 25x Spicier Than Normal — and Korea Can't Buy It

Description:
Samyang's Buldak Curry is a Korean brand you can only buy in Japan — it's sold at Don Quijote in Osaka but isn't officially distributed in Korea at all. It packs five spices (cumin, coriander, fenugreek, cardamom, and pepper) that hit right after the heat, and on the spice scale it lands about 25 times spicier than Curry LEE, the curry every Korean grew up calling "mild." Like Buldak fire noodles, it's the kind of spicy that makes you sweat and keep eating anyway.
